preconditions_before_any_database_open: reject missing, expired, changed, previously consumed or wrong-purpose approval
verify approval binds proposal ID, proposal manifest hash, locator file hash, requested stages, resource envelope and expected outputs
resolve the approved locator once without committing the path
capture size, modification time, header and bounded chunk identity
freeze the captured identity in the attempt manifest
revalidate the frozen identity immediately before SQLite open
runtime_requirements: PRAGMA query_only=ON verified before catalog statements
statement allowlist and write-token rejection before execution
every attempted statement recorded before execution with literals sanitized
temporary output outside the database and source directories
path aliases in committed output, never resolved personal paths
identity rechecked after every stage and immediately before finalization
immutable content-addressed audit artifacts and root manifest
terminal state COMPLETED, ABORTED or FAILED
one-use approval consumed atomically before the first database connection
statement_allowlist: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN without executing the explained query
implementation_gate: NO_EXECUTION_UNTIL_IMPLEMENTATION_EXISTS, OFFLINE SAFETY TESTS PASS, AND AN EXACT SEPARATE APPROVAL IS COMMITTED
